name: Upper Ideal in a Learning Space
statement: After a choice of coordinate signs and removal of constant coordinates, the family is a nonempty upper ideal $\mathcal C$ in a learning space $\mathcal L$ on the same active coordinates: if $F\in\mathcal C$, $G\in\mathcal L$, and $F\subseteq G$, then $G\in\mathcal C$.
comments: Complementation exchanges this presentation with the lower-ideal presentation for convex geometries.
